title: Subarray sum equals target
summary: Return how many runs of consecutive elements in `nums` add up to `target`.
hints: If you know the sum of the first j elements and the sum of the first i elements (with i < j), what is the sum of the elements between them?
A run sums to target exactly when two running totals differ by target. So at each position, ask: how many earlier running totals equal (current total - target)?
Keep a map from running total to how many times it has occurred, starting with total 0 seen once. At each element, update the total, add map[total - target] to the answer, then record the total.
takeaway: Running totals turn "sum of a range" into "difference of two totals", and a map finds the matching earlier total in one step: O(n). A sliding window does not work here, because negative numbers break it.
